objective: Replace selector-dependent root wording by a choice-free relational root contract requiring uniform coverage over every admissible C48 witness/gap description, demote unique JMAP from a mandatory root gate, and integrate the latest completed substantive S09/S10 deltas.

atomic_claims.text: For every actual unpaid negative face f, C48 gives a nonempty set Desc48(f) of admissible witness/gap descriptions. Root closure may proceed uniformly for every admissible description by existential elimination, with no canonical corner, canonical gap, or global choice function.

Under a nonempty source-generation relation and complete source-class coverage, unique JMAP/L_join identity is not logically required for root closure; duplicate descriptions may be retained. Uniqueness remains optional for normalization or separate payer-injectivity needs.

Merged S09 Cycle 4 shows R160 reduction coverage cannot be inverted into occurrence and, conditional on the exact selected C35/C36 J-source occurring in a vertex-minimum counterexample, the d(7)=6 equality case is killed by R160, hence d(7)>=7.

Merged S10 Cycle 3 fixes the two deletion holes to intersection {8,12} with no shared edge and exterior guard 8->12, so the unabsorbed lobes are a vertex-only two-terminal interface and cannot use the common-tournament ordinary-extension shortcut.
The live root gates are choice-free R_TOTAL, G_TOTAL, G_COVER, TNORM, TPROG, B-criticality, row-level LIFT-BIND, and trusted LIFT-VERIFY; generic LIFT-O theorem content remains candidate-PASS.

assumptions: C48/S01 Cycle-4 fixed-witness semantics remain in force; no face-level F/SG XOR is reintroduced.
All admissible witness/gap descriptions are actual descriptions from the selected negative face; root closure is uniform over them rather than selector-based.
Generation and classification relations are required nonempty/total so universal statements cannot close by vacuity.
S09 R160 remains a conditional d(7)=6 reduction library, not a source-occurrence theorem.
S10 corrected ownership is attributed to repository-bound C43/C47 content; no S04 identity-bound theorem is invented.
Ordinary and anchored lanes remain disjoint.
risks: Choice-free uniform coverage is stronger than merely proving that some convenient witness closes; no claim is made that R_TOTAL/G_TOTAL/G_COVER are already proved.
Unique mapping can still become necessary for a distinct payer-injectivity theorem, but such necessity must be proved rather than assumed.
The selected-J d(7)>=7 escape depends on preserved earlier C36 dependencies and remains candidate-level.
No normalized high-port termination theorem, B-criticality package, trusted verifier receipt, EvidenceLink, Result, or root closure exists.
